title: Model Scheduling and Caching
summary: This module manages the loading, unloading, and caching of AI models to optimize resource utilization and response times. It handles model lifecycle, memory management, and request scheduling.

nodes.label: Load Model into Scheduler
nodes.title: Load Model into Scheduler
nodes.description: Handles the core logic for loading a model, including resource allocation, GPU selection, and OOM retry mechanisms. It ensures models are loaded efficiently and gracefully handles resource constraints.

nodes.label: Get Model Runner
nodes.title: Get Model Runner
nodes.description: Retrieves an available model runner for a given request, managing pending requests and ensuring proper model loading or reuse.

nodes.label: Reload Same Model
nodes.title: Reload Same Model
nodes.description: Manages scenarios where the same model needs to be reloaded, potentially with updated configurations or adapters, ensuring efficient transitions.

nodes.label: Handle Multiple Loaded Models
nodes.title: Handle Multiple Loaded Models
nodes.description: Orchestrates the loading and unloading of multiple models, considering resource availability and eviction policies to maximize concurrency and throughput.

nodes.label: OOM Retry with Context Reduction
nodes.title: OOM Retry with Context Reduction
nodes.description: Implements a retry mechanism for out-of-memory (OOM) errors during model loading, automatically reducing context size to attempt successful loading.

nodes.label: Handle Canceled Requests
nodes.title: Handle Canceled Requests
nodes.description: Ensures that already canceled requests are gracefully handled, preventing unnecessary resource allocation or processing.

nodes.label: Apply Vision Context Floor
nodes.title: Apply Vision Context Floor
nodes.description: Enforces a minimum context size for vision models, ensuring they have sufficient context for processing, even if a smaller size is requested.

nodes.label: Manifest Name Reuse
nodes.title: Manifest Name Reuse
nodes.description: Tests the caching mechanism's ability to handle manifest name reuse, including case-insensitivity, ensuring consistent behavior across file systems.

nodes.label: Commit Blob to Cache
nodes.title: Commit Blob to Cache
nodes.description: Verifies the atomic commitment of blobs to the cache, including updates and timestamp management, ensuring data integrity.

nodes.label: Import Blob to Cache
nodes.title: Import Blob to Cache
nodes.description: Tests the import functionality for blobs, ensuring data is correctly stored and retrieved, and handles duplicate imports efficiently.

nodes.label: Basic Blob Cache Operations
nodes.title: Basic Blob Cache Operations
nodes.description: Covers fundamental cache operations like resolving, getting, and putting blobs, including error handling for non-existent or invalid entries.

nodes.label: Put Blob with Validation
nodes.title: Put Blob with Validation
nodes.description: Validates the 'put' operation for blobs, ensuring content integrity, size matching, and proper error handling for corrupted or mismatched data.

nodes.label: Put and Get Zero-Length Blob
nodes.title: Put and Get Zero-Length Blob
nodes.description: Tests the cache's behavior with zero-length blobs, ensuring proper handling and error reporting when a blob's content is unexpectedly truncated.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: Handles incoming requests for model interactions like chat, generation, and embedding.

groups.label: Model Scheduling
groups.title: Model Scheduling
groups.description: Manages the lifecycle of AI models, including loading, unloading, and optimizing their placement and execution based on resource availability and request patterns.

groups.label: Blob Caching
groups.title: Blob Caching
groups.description: Provides a robust caching mechanism for model binaries and associated data, ensuring data integrity, efficient storage, and retrieval.
